card.line: Chorazin was a city where Jesus did many miracles, but its people did not repent, so He warned them of judgment.

moments.title: Jesus warns Chorazin
moments.text: Jesus spoke sadly about cities where He did most of His miracles, because the people did not turn from their sins. He said, "Woe to you, Chorazin!"

moments.title: Woe to Chorazin in Luke
moments.text: Luke also records Jesus saying, "Woe to you, Chorazin!" He said Tyre and Sidon would have turned from their sins long ago if they had seen those miracles.
